Container.Name: Minifold
Container.Overview: Minifold - a lightweight self-hosted file compressor. Drag and drop images, PDFs, videos or any other file, pick a level, and download smaller files. Everything is processed on this server; nothing is sent anywhere else. Admin page at /admin. Optional GPU video encoding: Intel/AMD - add --device=/dev/dri --group-add=GID to Extra Parameters (GID from: stat -c %g /dev/dri/renderD128); NVIDIA - add --runtime=nvidia and the variables NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,video,utility.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Files while they're being compressed. Deleted automatically by the retention settings. Needs free space of at least 2.5x the max file size.

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: Password for everyone using Minifold (at least 16 characters). Leave empty and Minifold generates one on first start: it's shown once in the container log and saved in /mnt/user/appdata/minifold/config/tokens.toml.

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Password for the admin page (/admin), different from the access token. Leave empty to have one generated, like the access token.
